newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: World Court to hear Hungary-Slovakia dam dispute.
newsitem.headline: World Court to hear Hungary-Slovakia dam dispute.

text.p: The International Court of Justice said on Thursday it would open hearings on March 3 in a dispute between Hungary and Slovakia over the latter's diversion of the Danube's waters for a hydroelectric power project.
Slovakia unilaterally diverted a long stretch of the Danube in 1992 to build the Gabcikovo dam after Hungary withdrew from a joint agreement for a similar dam at Nagymaros in Hungary.

Slovakia alleges Hungary breached contractual obligations while the Hungarians say diverting the river, which forms the border between the two countries, breaks international law and has caused widespread ecological damage.
The International Court of Justice is the main judicial organ of the United Nations and settles disputes between states in accordance with international law.
